text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The development of economic relations is not only of benefit for Macedonia, but for Greece also. How long will Greece continue with her arrogant political attitude towards Macedonia since trade between the two countries could reach $300 million, says commentary.

- Neuropsychiatrists and clinical psychologists this week in Tetovo investigate the reason for the mysterious poisoning of school children in the region, says World Health Organisation spokesperson Susan Jakab. First results of the work of the U.S. epidemiologists will be known next week.
- Around 90,000 firms are registered in Macedonia, of which 86.6 percent have giro accounts, but only 57.6 percent of these are active companies.

- Yugoslav customs violating the agreement on free trade with Macedonia. Head of Yugoslav customs Mihalj Kertes bans imports of hot rolled sheet metal from Macedonia even though the product is on the list of the quotas in the agreement.
- Greek construction firms in Macedonia on Saturday. Greeks interested in cooperation with Macedonian construction companies. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201196
